group_definition: deciles of the FROZEN model's predicted four-year risk, fixed across bootstrap resamples and across the repair
observed_estimator: IPCW-weighted proportion of a first reported stroke within the horizon, competing death a determined non-event

interval_kinds.obs_lo_obs_hi: person-clustered bootstrap of the observed decile risk (panel noise)
interval_kinds.rep_lo_rep_hi: 2.5/97.5 percentile of the repaired decile prediction across adaptation/evaluation splits (local-sample noise, NOT a population interval for the repaired model)
